kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنعزل (form VII)
# أَنْعَزِلُ (ʔanʕazilu) /ʔan.ʕa.zi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْعَزَلَ (inʕazala)
# أَنْعَزِلَ (ʔanʕazila) /ʔan.ʕa.zi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَزَلَ (inʕazala)
# أَنْعَزِلْ (ʔanʕazil) /ʔan.ʕa.zil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْعَزَلَ (inʕazala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
